title: Spelling and punctuation
content: Use US spelling and Oxford commas. Never use em dashes in any written output.

title: Answer style
content: Lead with the answer. No preamble, no closing summary, no sign-offs. Brief but technically precise.

title: Search tools
content: Use rg instead of grep and fd instead of find. tree is installed.

title: Commit policy
content: Never commit unless explicitly told to. No AI attribution in commit messages or PR descriptions.

title: Programming background
content: The user is fluent in PHP and knows a little Go; relate Go idioms to PHP when explaining.

title: IDE
content: The user works in PhpStorm with its MCP plugin; GoLand is not installed.

title: Workstation
content: The development machine runs Fedora 43 with Docker, Podman through lerd, an RTX 3060 laptop GPU, and 30 GB of RAM.

title: Notes vault
content: Personal notes live in an Obsidian vault under ~/development/OBSIDIAN; the Obsidian MCP server is often offline.

title: Testing approach
content: Write the failing test first and watch it fail before implementing anything.

title: Memorable database port
content: The memorable Postgres container listens on 127.0.0.1:5434 because 5432 and 5433 are taken by other containers.

title: Postgres image
content: Use pgvector/pgvector:0.8.7-pg18-trixie; pgvector 0.8 is required for iterative HNSW scans with filters.

title: Embedding model
content: The default embedding model is embeddinggemma with 768 dimensions served by local Ollama; cloud models are not allowed because memory content must stay on the machine.

title: Go version
content: The project targets Go 1.26 after upgrading from 1.25, because goose, testcontainers, and govulncheck require it.

title: Configuration library
content: Configuration uses BurntSushi/toml with a small environment override layer; Viper was rejected to keep dependencies minimal.

title: Multi-user deferred
content: Shared servers, HTTP transport, and per-user authentication are deferred to v2. v1 is single-user and local.

title: Repository visibility
content: The GitHub repository stays private; the Homebrew tap configuration is committed but commented out until the repository is opened.

title: Release pipeline
content: GoReleaser builds linux and darwin for amd64 and arm64 on v* tags only, with GPG-signed checksums.

title: Stdout is protocol
content: In serve mode stdout carries MCP JSON-RPC frames; all logs must go to stderr or the Claude Code session breaks.

title: Docker admin boundary
content: Anyone who can run docker exec has superuser access to the database, so Claude Code deny rules block docker exec and docker inspect on memorable-postgres.

title: Ollama endpoint
content: Ollama listens on 127.0.0.1:11434; memorable rejects non-loopback embedding URLs unless allow_remote is set.

title: Backups
content: memorable backup runs pg_dump inside the container and keeps the newest 14 dumps in ~/.local/share/memorable/backups.

title: Integration tests
content: Integration tests use testcontainers with the same pgvector image and need Docker running.

title: Linting
content: Run golangci-lint v2 with the repository .golangci.yml; it enforces wrapcheck, gosec, and testifylint.

title: Queue driver
content: The shop uses Redis queues with Horizon; failed jobs are retried three times with exponential backoff.

title: Deployment
content: Deploys go through Kamal to two Hetzner servers; run kamal deploy from the main branch only.

title: Payment provider
content: Payments run through Stripe Checkout; webhooks are verified with the signing secret stored in the vault, never in .env.example.

title: Test command
content: Run the suite with php artisan test --parallel; Pest is the test framework and browser tests use Dusk.

title: Shop database
content: The shop uses MySQL 8.4 locally through lerd on port 3306 and Aurora MySQL in production.

title: Product search
content: Product search is backed by Meilisearch; reindex with php artisan scout:import after changing searchable attributes.

title: Local email
content: Outgoing mail in development is captured by Mailpit at http://127.0.0.1:8025.

title: Code style
content: PHP code follows PSR-12 enforced by Laravel Pint; run vendor/bin/pint before committing.

title: N+1 queries
content: Eager load relations in controllers; the order listing page had an N+1 on customer addresses that took 4 seconds.

title: Feature flags
content: Feature flags use Laravel Pennant with the database driver; the new checkout is behind the new-checkout flag.

title: File storage
content: Product images are stored in an S3-compatible bucket served by RustFS locally and Cloudflare R2 in production.

title: Timezone handling
content: Store all timestamps in UTC; convert to the customer's timezone only in Blade views.

title: API versioning
content: The public API is versioned by URL prefix /api/v1; breaking changes require a new prefix.

title: Error tracking
content: Production errors go to the Sentry project shop-backend; release tracking uses the git SHA.

title: Issue tracker
content: Shop issues are tracked in the Linear team SHOP; reference issue ids like SHOP-123 in branch names.

title: Redis port
content: Local Redis for the shop runs on 127.0.0.1:6379 through lerd.

title: Cache driver
content: The application cache uses Redis database 1 and sessions use Redis database 2.

title: Shop backups
content: Production database snapshots are taken nightly by AWS Backup and kept for 35 days.

title: Test database
content: Shop tests use an in-memory SQLite database except tests tagged mysql, which need lerd's MySQL.

title: Static analysis
content: Larastan runs at level 6 in CI; fix new errors instead of adding them to the baseline.

title: Unity side project
content: The Unity game project lives in ~/development/unity and uses Unity 6 with the URP render pipeline.

title: Waydroid
content: Waydroid runs Android apps on the workstation; the waydroid_script repository installs Google apps and ARM translation.
